test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of 'The Turbulent Years : 1980 - 1996'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pranab Mukherjee.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pranab Mukherjee is the author of The Turbulent Years : 1980 - 1996.**
 
• His other books are '**Thoughts and Reflections', 'Beyond Survival'.**
 
• Pranab Kumar Mukherjee was an Indian politician who served as the 13th president of India from 2012 until 2017.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PV Narasimha Rao** is known as the 'Father of Indian Economics Reforms'.

 
 
• He served as the 10th Prime Minister of India from **1991 to 1996.**
 
• He is known for launching free-market reform in India that brought it back from near bankruptcy also commonly known as LPG.
 
 
 
• Manmohan Singh served as the finance minister during the 1991 economic reforms.
 
 
• He was the finance minister in the PV Narasimha Rao government.
 
• Manmohan Singh was the 13th Prime Minister of India (2004 to 2014).
 
 
 
• **Kamal Nath** is a politician and former Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
• He has served as the Minister of Urban Development.
 
• He is a member and was the Pro Term Speaker of the 16th Lok Sabha of India.
